hook: I spent 3 hours testing TestStartupAI's product loop. The core vision is brilliant, but I identified a key friction point for your Pre-seed / Seed (0→1) roadmap.

friction_points.title: Time-to-Value (TTV) Friction
friction_points.description: The initial onboarding flow delays the core magic moment. We need to get early users to 'Aha!' in under 10 seconds.

architecture_hypothesis: Speculative client-side rendering with optimistic UI updates. Product Builder match
